statement: Every remaining nonidentity cubic multiplier coordinate gives an actual quotient of the full torus free group onto Z_q semidirect C3 on which the prescribed order-three representative acts identically. The full chosen section centralizer maps onto Z_q with an explicit procyclic-power splitting. Its kernels at every finite q-power level and at the infinite level have zero first mod-three cohomology. All these kernel extensions have exactly three labelled full section classes with exact normalizers. The finite covers have type ((3q^n-1)/2,3), and their nontrivial rotation cohomology is free of rank q^n-1 over Z3[C3]. The actual order-9q quotient proves that every homomorphism C3 coproduct C3 into the full extension has proper closed image.

notes: The original integral character has values 0,1,omega,omega squared on the index-three Schreier basis, so it defines the full Z_q quotient before reduction. D71's mod-q surjectivity and closedness force the fixed subgroup onto Z_q; taking the q-primary power of an actual preimage of one supplies the splitting. For every q-power cover the exact graph module is Z3 plus three regular rotation modules. The unramified paired rank-three fixed-cup proof gives regular cubic lattices at every nontrivial rotation character, and Brown restriction gives zero first cohomology of each fixed kernel. A continuous character on the intersection extends through one of those actual open kernels, proving the limit vanishing. The two global section-image types are the central s and r^a t^-1 s; their pairwise generated images are explicitly proper in Q1 times C3. No scalar cubic realization or exclusion, finite-type surface description of the infinite kernel, full fixed-group recognition, or generation by sections is asserted.
